zh-CN.adminScopeNotice: 此身份仅在当前社区生效，不授予其他社区或网站后台权限。
zh-CN.adminClaimSetting: 允许管理员认领待处理工单
zh-CN.adminClaimSettingNote: 认领前只显示编号、类别和等待时间。「仅联系社区主」的工单不会出现在认领列表中。
zh-CN.adminAllowStaff: 社区主或指定的管理员
zh-CN.adminPrivacyNotice: 只有你、社区主和当前处理人可以阅读。允许管理员处理时，管理员可按社区设置认领；认领前只能看到编号、类别和等待时间。仅联系社区主的工单转交前必须征得你的同意。
zh-CN.adminRedactedQueue: 认领后才能查看主题、正文和附件。
zh-CN.adminNoClaimable: 暂时没有可认领的工单
zh-CN.adminHandoffRequest: 社区主希望将此工单交给「{name}」处理。对方将在你同意后看到这张工单的完整历史和附件。
zh-CN.adminConsentWaiting: 等待当事人确认；拟接手人员目前无法查看。
zh-CN.adminOwnerOnlyHandoff: 此工单仅联系社区主。选择新的处理人后，会先向当事人请求同意，不会立即开放内容。
zh-CN.adminAssignmentNotice: 新处理人将看到原有历史和附件，旧处理人会立即失去访问权限。
zh-CN.adminAccessRevoked: 你已不再是此工单的处理人，无法继续查看或回复。
zh-CN.adminProactivePrivacy: 此工单默认仅你和当事成员可读。选择管理员后，会先请求当事成员同意。
zh-CN.adminInitialAssignment: 拟接手的管理员（需当事人同意）
zh-CN.adminHandlerError: 请选择本社区有工单处理权限的管理员。
zh-CN.adminClaimDisabledError: 当前社区未开放管理员认领，请联系社区主指派。
zh-CN.adminClaimConflictError: 工单已被其他人认领或状态已改变，请刷新队列。
zh-CN.adminConsentRequiredError: 请先请求当事人同意转交，再指派新的处理人。
zh-CN.adminConsentStaleError: 转交请求已改变，请刷新工单后重试。
zh-CN.adminConsentParticipantError: 只有工单当事人可以同意或拒绝转交。
zh-CN.adminRealtimeClosing: 连接正在关闭，请稍后重试。
zh-CN.workbenchWaitingHint: 按最后一条未撤回消息的发送者判断。
zh-CN.workbenchClosedNotice: 工单已关闭，历史仍可查看。重开后可以继续回复。

en.adminScopeNotice: This role applies only to this community. It grants no access to other communities or site administration.
en.adminClaimSetting: Allow admins to claim waiting tickets
en.adminClaimSettingNote: Before claiming, admins see only the number, category and waiting time. Owner-only tickets never appear in this queue.
en.adminAllowStaff: Community owner or an assigned administrator
en.adminPrivacyNotice: Only you, the community owner and the current handler can read this ticket. If you allow staff, admins may claim it when the community enables claiming; beforehand they see only its number, category and waiting time. Owner-only tickets require your consent before a handoff.
en.adminRedactedQueue: Claim a ticket to see its subject, messages and attachments.
en.adminHandoffRequest: The community owner would like {name} to handle this ticket. If you agree, they will be able to read its full history and attachments.
en.adminConsentWaiting: Waiting for the participant’s consent. The proposed handler cannot read this ticket yet.
en.adminOwnerOnlyHandoff: This ticket is owner-only. Selecting a new handler requests the participant’s consent; it does not grant immediate access.
en.adminAssignmentNotice: The new handler will see the existing history and attachments. The previous handler loses access immediately.
en.adminAccessRevoked: You are no longer assigned to this ticket and cannot read or reply to it.
en.adminProactivePrivacy: This ticket is initially private to you and the member. Selecting an administrator will request the member’s consent first.
en.adminHandlerError: Choose an administrator in this community who can handle tickets.
en.adminClaimDisabledError: Self-service claiming is disabled here. Ask the community owner to assign a ticket.
en.adminClaimConflictError: This ticket has been claimed or its status has changed. Refresh the queue.
en.adminConsentRequiredError: Request the participant’s consent before assigning a new handler.
en.adminConsentStaleError: The handoff request has changed. Refresh the ticket and try again.
en.adminConsentParticipantError: Only the ticket participant can approve or decline a handoff.
en.adminRealtimeClosing: The connection is closing. Try again shortly.
en.workbenchWaitingHint: Based on who sent the latest message that has not been retracted.
en.workbenchClosedNotice: This ticket is closed. You can still read its history. Reopen it to continue the conversation.
